description: Set how pages reach the person signed in, as their How to Reach Me ladder: a step for each way and wait, for every incident and alert at every severity. It replaces how pages reach them now; steps on their custom channels are kept. Each way reaches their own verified methods of it: a way with none is left out, and details say where to verify one. It never adds a phone number or the app. A ladder that reaches them this way already is left as it is. Only the person signed in (OAuth) sets their own; an API key has nobody to set it for.

steps.description: In order: [{ by: 'sms', afterMinutes: 0 }, { by: 'call', afterMinutes: 5 }] is 'text me, then call me after five minutes'.

afterMinutes.description: Minutes after the page starts, 0 to 1440. Defaults to 0, at once.

name: set_how_to_reach_me
title: Set How To Reach Me
